current_answer: AWS now offers agent-assisted preparation for Activate applications, but the applicant reviews and submits. The agent page says “paid support plan” while the main Activate page says “Paid Tier Plan.” AWS separates Paid account plans from paid Support subscriptions. Founders remains a direct self-funded route starting at USD 1,000, with selected applicants possibly reaching USD 5,000; Portfolio needs a provider Org ID. Do not buy Support solely from the agent page wording; verify the current flow or ask AWS.

catalogue_card.question: Does an AWS credit application need paid Support?
catalogue_card.text: The new agent-assisted page says “paid support plan,” but the main Activate page says “Paid Tier Plan.” AWS treats these as different products. You review and submit any agent-prepared application. Confirm the agent-route requirement with AWS before buying Support.

summary: AWS Startup Advisor can prepare an Activate application; the applicant reviews and submits.
The agent page says paid support plan; the main programme says Paid Tier Plan. AWS Billing distinguishes Paid account plans from Support subscriptions.
Founders starts at USD 1,000 for self-funded startups; selected applicants may get up to USD 5,000. Portfolio requires an Activate Provider Org ID.
